body_lead: Patna, Oct 22 (IANS) The Bihar government has set a target of providing Artificial Intelligence (AI) training to five lakh students over the next five years to enhance their employability and prepare them for emerging technological demands. Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary chaired a review meeting on the proposed Bihar Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026 at Sankalp Hall in Lok Sevak Awas on Thursday, where officials discussed measures to promote AI-based innovation, attract investment and generate employment opportunities in the state.
